body:
## Priority

Recommended build order across the 2026-07-18 content audit (#529-#533): **#531 (cheapest win) -> #530 (biggest prize) -> #529 (gated on Daft Q2 2026 report) -> #533 -> #532.**

This issue: **#3 of 5, priority:medium** — the quarterly series is due and it's the Q2 press hook, but it's data-gated: Daft Q2 2026 report likely not published until late July/August. Bump to priority:high once the report is live.

---

## What
Add `dublin_q2_2026` to the rent-data series registry (`server/src/content/rent_post.gleam`, alongside `dublin_q1_2026`). Sitemap and `/resources` hub surface automatically from the `posts` const.

## Why (keyword evidence, Keyword Planner IE, pulled 2026-07-18)
- "average rent dublin" 480/mo x3 variants, "dublin rent prices" 90/mo x2, "average rent in dublin for a room" 30/mo — ~1,800/mo combined, LOW competition
- The Q1 post is now a quarter stale; the series premise is point-in-time figures superseded quarterly, never edited

## Data sources (VERIFY before prod, per the registry's own standing rule)
- Daft.ie Rental Report Q2 2026 (asking rents) — **ship gate: confirm the Q2 report is actually published before drafting figures** (Q1's report was the basis in June; Q2 typically lands late July/August)
- RTB/ESRI Rent Index, latest available (Q1 2026 if published)
- Keep the three-figure discipline: asking vs new-registered vs existing-registered rents, never conflated
- Headline figure table gets its `VERIFY before prod` comment, same as Q1

## Also in scope
- The post derives cap/CPI from `content/rpz`'s `cpi` const (currently 360bps, "May 2026", checked 25 June 2026). CSO June 2026 CPI lands mid-July — if it differs from 3.6%, bump all three const fields in the same PR (the cpi-freshness workflow may already have filed a reminder; don't duplicate).
- Marketing note (no code): this post is the Q2 press-pitch hook — flag Herald when it ships.

## Acceptance
- `/resources/dublin-rents-q2-2026` renders, 404s nothing, appears in sitemap.xml + `/resources` hub newest-first
- All € figures verified against the live reports named in the sources block
- No hardcoded cap percentage in copy (derives from `rpz`)
title: Content: Dublin Rents Q2 2026 post (quarterly rent-data series)
